summary: The task was successfully completed using the existing inventory-metrics-calculation skill. The agent adapted it to a freshness/expiration domain (meal kits with expiring boxes and shelf-life constraints). The existing skill already covers the core calculation workflow, but lacked explicit guidance on the freshness/expiration variant. This update adds that variant to the known invariants section, documents the expiration adjustment step, and clarifies the Shelf_Life sheet pattern so future agents recognize this as a standard variant rather than a new capability.
